partner_results_applied.application: conditional affine principal-block bound C_d/sigma_min(B) and C_0 regularity for the global affine target
the target-valid A_T=diag(1,1,1,T^-3) family has s_3=1 and rules out any uniform tail envelope even after the new normalization

new_mathematics.statement: The sharp universal constant is unchanged by arbitrary deterministic affine terms: C_aff=C_hom. Proof uses one extra cap-one coordinate, Cauchy interlacing, and weak-limit lower semicontinuity of interval concentration. The sharp problem also reduces exactly to s_3(A)=1.
new_mathematics.nonclaim: No universal height bound is proved; normalized s_3=1 target densities need not have a uniform tail envelope.

unresolved_implication: Prove a dimension- and matrix-independent bound on max_t p_Q(t) over the normalized class s_3(A)=1; reciprocal principal-minor payment can still diverge and no compact output-location reduction is available.
next_step: Feed exact affine closure and s_3=1 normalization into the product-preserving high-leverage/near-isotropic aggregate bridge; do not apply the affine closure to conditional Hessian blocks lacking three protected eigenvalues.
